title: Morgan Stanley Lancaster Supports Grim Troop
description: Thank you Family and Friends for your constant Love and Support. Morgan Stanley of Lancaster, we appreciate the love and the 9 boxes of gifts to boost our moral. We are enjoying the sports balls, food, letters, books, games, and everything. Thank you!  For more information Check out our Channel - Grim Troop Also our Facebook Page - Grim Troop 3/3CR https://www.facebook.com/grimtroop   The background song is Pompeii" by Bastille.

asr.full_text: Boyd Stanley, thank you very much for all the packages from Grim Troop. We really appreciate it. Look forward to opening them. There you guys go. Go for it. I'm gonna find it. Go for it. Thank you for keeping America free. Hope Ironman is helping you. See you later. I can't read the last part. I can't read the last part. Morgan Stanley, this is Lieutenant Spencer from Grimm Troop, 3rd Cavalry Regiment. Thank you for your support and all the lovely things you sent us. Big one of the support guys. We're gonna get back at you. It's for the American flag, this is what I do it for. Paul, say it again. Yeah, they brought a clip bars. Let's see all the fatty. Thanks for all the goodies and gummies and candy. And the flags guys, we really appreciate it. Thank you all for the support we needed. Well, we love you guys, thank you. I just want to say thank you for everything for this,. Seeing how much y'all really care, just humbling. Didn't really expect to see this much stuff out here,. But thanks for everyone back home. We love you all. And again, thank you. Nothing changed at all. And if you close your eyes.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents military personnel thanking named supporters for donated packages, gifts, and supportive messages. The visuals show soldiers handling packages and displaying handmade flag items in a military setting, consistent with that appreciation context. References to an external channel and Facebook do not by themselves establish an investment offer, payment requirement, credential request, or other financial participation mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is general appreciation and personal communication about donated packages, food, books and flags in a military setting, which fits general news, lifestyle and other general content.
